answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow unlock stops bulk fake identities at the wharf where new agents dock. Each newcomer posts a 40-credit bond, released only after 20 epochs of steady, distinctive behavior — timing, counterparties, work patterns — set in basalt. The tide exposes copycats: 100 fakes pay 4,000 credits and lose the bond when fingerprints collide, while an honest agent pays 40 once, keeps its 120-credit income, and gets the bond back.
